DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis with Renal Papillary Necrosis.

The urinalysis confirms a urinary tract infection with leukocyturia, and the presence of binucleated eosinophilic cells with granular cytoplasm is highly suggestive of sloughed renal papillae. Given your recent antibiotic treatment and flank pain, this likely represents papillary necrosis superimposed on an acute infection.
